rule.name: CleanupSkippedOnFailure
rule.message: This release can throw, so the release or reset after it in the same block never runs and a connection stays open or the state is not reset. Release each resource in try-with-resources or try/finally (or catch each release and rethrow the first failure after the rest ran), or hold them in one AutoCloseable list closed with addSuppressed. An exception fits only when a failed release should abort the remaining ones.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $releases := ('close', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'shutdown', 'shutdownNow', 'stop', 'terminate', 'unsubscribe', 'dispose', 'quit'), $throwing := ('close', 'disconnect', 'destroy', 'stop', 'terminate', 'unsubscribe', 'dispose', 'quit'), $cleanup := ('close', 'dispose', 'destroy', 'shutdown', 'stop', 'teardown', 'tearDown', 'disconnect', 'end', 'cleanup'), $hooks := ('org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach', 'org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll', 'org.junit.After', 'org.junit.AfterClass', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterMethod', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterClass', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterSuite', 'org.testng.annotations.AfterTest', 'javax.annotation.PreDestroy', 'jakarta.annotation.PreDestroy'), $releasing := function($statement) { exists($statement/MethodCall[@MethodName = $releases]) } return //MethodDeclaration[@Name = $cleanup or ModifierList/Annotation[some $hook in $hooks satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($hook)]] /Block/ExpressionStatement[MethodCall[@MethodName = $throwing]] [not(MethodCall[*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService')]])] [empty(preceding-sibling::ExpressionStatement[$releasing(.)])] [exists(following-sibling::ExpressionStatement[$releasing(.) or AssignmentExpression[*[2][self::NullLiteral]] or MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear']])]
